title: LACUNA first-cut edit operations (per-track, raw time)
description: Output the AI editor must produce. Every op references the raw host tracks only, by token id (e.g. L000812 / P000045, from the editor input) or by raw seconds. Token-id ranges are inclusive and cover whole tokens: from = start of the first token, to = end of the last token. A number is a raw time in seconds on that track. Ops never add audio. Anything not covered by an op is kept as recorded.

model.description: free text: which model / prompt produced this

track.description: L = Leon track, P = Pei track, both = the same raw time range on both tracks

point.description: token id (string, e.g. 'L000812') or raw seconds (number). For track 'both' use raw seconds (a token id of either track is accepted and resolved to its time).

category.description: pause = silence only; disfluency = 嗯/呃/false start/stumble; repetition = involuntary repeat; crosstalk = overlapping speech made sequential or removed; content = whole phrases/topics removed; interjection_move = an interjection slid in time or deleted; single_track_noise = breath/click/cough/noise on one track

reason.description: one short sentence (Chinese is fine) a human reviewer can check

confidence.description: probability Leon would make the same edit here

oneOf.title: cut
oneOf.description: Remove raw audio [from, to] on the given track(s). On a single track this shortens that track only (the renderer keeps the other track continuous); to silence a short sound under the other host's speech without moving anything, cut it on its own track with category single_track_noise.

oneOf.title: tighten_pause
oneOf.description: Shorten one pause to target_s seconds (removal taken from its middle). 'at' = token id the pause FOLLOWS (pause on that token's track), or a raw time inside the pause. track 'both' = a floor gap where neither host speaks; it is shortened on both tracks.

oneOf.title: slip
oneOf.description: Move the raw range [from, to] of one track by delta_s seconds relative to the other track (positive = later, i.e. the interjection lands later in the other host's speech). Used for interjection_move / crosstalk serialisation. Does not delete audio.

oneOf.title: keep_flag
oneOf.description: Do nothing, but flag [from, to] for human review (uncertain: possible edit that the editor chose NOT to make).
